Sanjeev Jain Named India's Next Ambassador to North Korea

Sanjeev Jain has been appointed as India's next ambassador to North Korea. This diplomatic appointment signifies India's continued engagement with the reclusive East Asian nation. The role involves representing India's interests and fostering bilateral relations.
